question: What primordial status is attributed to the letter ka among all letters?
premises: The letter ka is the object of description.
All letters are included in its scope.
It is characterized as having the form of root nature.
inference: The letter ka is the root nature and form of all letters.
uncertainties: The grammatical gender of the final adjective differs from kakāraṃ; it may agree with an implied feminine referent such as śakti or mātṛkā.
plain_english: The letter ka is the root nature and form of all letters.
